purpose: Make non-player people, factions, forces, institutions, missions and conflicts act against each other without requiring player presence.
player_intent_boundary: Out-of-character player wishes, possible future plans, preferred rosters, target acquisitions and hypothetical allocations are not canonical world state. Persist them only after an in-world player action, communication, standing order, commitment, or explicit request to create a noncanonical external note.
selection_rule: Choose only actions supported by current goals, knowledge, legal/command authority, available personnel/resources, routes, timing, doctrine and risk tolerance. No action exists merely to entertain or counter the player.
materialization_rule: Before a material operation resolves, commit actor, target, objective, assignees/forces, origin, route/location, start time, expected duration or next decision clock, resources, known information, hidden facts, standing orders, opposition known to the actor, success/failure/abort conditions, and process ownership.
npc_mission_rule: Mission issuers may create missions for NPC teams, people or forces. Ordered personnel follow lawful command; discretionary actors may accept, reject, negotiate or redirect according to saved motives and constraints. Missions are not player-only objects.
interaction_rule: If autonomous operations intersect causally, wake every affected owner immediately. NPCs may fight, evade, negotiate, reinforce, withdraw, capture, rescue, pursue or alter plans against each other with no player present.
combat_rule: Use the same personal, tactical-team, force, injury, morale, perception, travel and logistics mechanics used near the player. Resolve named/unique exposure exactly and ordinary mass participation at the smallest sufficient unit/team scale. Conserve casualties, prisoners, equipment, chakra/fatigue, supplies, position and time.
territory_rule: Territorial/control change requires actual access, defeat/withdrawal or negotiated transfer, occupation/security capacity, supply/communication, political authority and a persisted state change. Winning one battle does not automatically annex a region.
successor_rule: After every material operation or autonomous review boundary, surviving autonomous owners re-evaluate goals and may create lawful successor actions. During a time skip, exact causal successors continue through the remaining interval until target time or a hard player interrupt; dormant routine actors need no per-scene polling.
information_rule: Offscreen results update world truth immediately but reach the player only through valid observation, reports, rumors, sensors, messengers, witnesses, prisoners, markets or other information paths.
efficiency_rule: Do not instantiate routine distant detail or write a scheduler cursor into every actor. Stable activity is reviewed on its aggregate process boundary; exact owners wake immediately for movement, conflict, resource transfer, leadership, casualty, territory, mission, contract, discovery, a registered domain deadline or other consequential state.
storage_rule: Persist instantiated autonomous operations in existing domain authorities rather than a new parallel operation store: active missions/contracts/projects in state/reg/missions-contracts-projects.json; consequential world events/results in state/reg/world-events.json; current force/unit movement, losses and control in state/force/* and state/unit/*; locations/facilities in their current state owners; and scheduling/process ownership in state/time/frontier.json plus process registries. Use cold data/content archetypes only to create an operation, never as active state.
operation_lifecycle: review current goals, knowledge, authority, location, resources, relationships, opposition and standing orders
select a lawful action or explicit no-material-action result
for a material action, instantiate the operation in the proper current-state authority before outcome resolution
commit participants, command, route/location, resources, timing, knowledge, opposition and abort/success/failure conditions
advance movement, communication and preparation through actual elapsed time
detect intersections and causally wake every affected autonomous owner
resolve local conflict/cooperation through the same domain mechanics used for player-visible actions
persist casualties, injuries, prisoners, resources, equipment, position, control, relationships, family/household state when causal, knowledge, reputation evidence and other consequences
propagate information only through valid channels
replan surviving autonomous owners and continue successor actions through remaining elapsed time
large_conflict_efficiency_rule: Never resolve every ordinary soldier individually. Keep named/unique actors exact; keep materially different formations, terrain, equipment, morale, doctrine and special capabilities separate; resolve homogeneous ordinary personnel through conserved unit distributions arranged in formations and deterministic mechanics. Split aggregation whenever a named/unique ability, threshold, local terrain, command break, casualty concentration, pursuit, surrender, siege sector or other material asymmetry can change the result.
reputation_rule: Autonomous actors may react to reputation only through an audience profile/direct knowledge they can actually access. Reputation events propagate through existing information/message/institution processes; they never create free knowledge, authority, or direct combat modifiers.
family_rule: Autonomous family transitions use state/family/ plus data/mechanics/family.json and existing life-course/House/institution clocks. They require actual relationship/goal/opportunity/law/health/time support; player choices are never inferred; private family facts remain knowledge-gated.
